subject: Money
title: Inflation Indexed Contracts
description: A quick, practical guide to Inflation Indexed Contracts.

hook.text: In Brazil, everything adjusts for inflation: rent, wages, even school tuition. Monthly contracts move with the index.

buildup.text: Countries with high inflation history build escalation clauses into contracts. Protection is automated.

discovery.text: Cost-of-living adjustments in Social Security raise benefits annually based on CPI. Retirees get inflation protection.

twist.text: Indexation protects individuals but can entrench inflation. When every contract adjusts upward, inflation locks in.

climax.text: It's a paradox: protecting against inflation makes inflation harder to stop. Defense becomes the disease.

quiz.question: Why can inflation indexation entrench inflation?
options: Automatic adjustments keep pushing prices upward
